title: Bounded vertical deviations and irrational circle factors in Dehn Twist classes
summary: We prove that a homeomorphism of the two-torus in a Dehn twist homotopy class is a topological extension of an irrational circle rotation if and only if its vertical rotation set reduces to a single irrational number and the homeomorphism exhibits uniformly bounded rotational deviations in the vertical direction. This result has been previously obtained by the second author under an additional hypothesis about the geometry of the non-wandering set.
